public.text: The phrase “not a pilot that would require reconstruction before it can scale” is directionally useful but may discourage safe experimentation and learning.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish disposable pilots from production-oriented pilots. Require bounded implementation that uses target standards and governance, tests assumptions, and can be scaled or deliberately retired based on evidence.
